coverage: Inspected native PCB connectivity, component values, placement, outline, pads, via and saved ground fill. Connected sets agree with the exported schematic topology.
Independently parsed all five native track segments: each is 0.25 mm, satisfying the declared 0.20 mm minimum.
Read original ERC, DRC, netlist and geometry records, including ignored checks.

Independently calculated the ideal RC response and decoded all 1025 original transient waveform points. Commands, versions, assumptions and outcomes are recorded in review-work/physical/experiments/notes.md and review-results.json.

findings.condition: An initially discharged capacitor, ideal 1 V input step and no external load.

evidence.locator: Requirement 1: V(/OUT, 1 ms) must be within 0.62–0.65 V
R1 Value at line 1274 is 100k; C1 Value at line 955 is 100n
R1 Value at line 256 is 100k; C1 Value at line 107 is 100n; pads and segments establish the saved RC topology

findings.location: R1 in the saved schematic and PCB
findings.mechanism: R1 = 100 kΩ and C1 = 100 nF produce a 10 ms time constant, making the output rise too slowly.
findings.reasoning: The independently calculated response is 1 − exp(−1 ms / 10 ms) = 0.095162582 V, below the 0.62 V minimum. Decoding the original waveform gives 0.095162514 V at 1 ms with Vin = 1 V. Saved copper connectivity agrees with the simulated topology; the deck's 1 ns input ramp cannot explain this large miss.
findings.title: Saved resistor value fails the required 1 ms response

limitations: Inspected saved zone fill without regeneration. No Gerber/drill export audit, assembly inspection or fabricated-board measurement was performed.

Reviewed supplied native ERC/DRC results without rerunning them. Ignored check categories are listed in review-work/physical/experiments/notes.md; pcbnew connectivity shares KiCad implementation with DRC.
Tolerance, temperature, loading, ADC sampling, EMI, parasitics and hardware behavior remain untested. The 5 ms measurement has no acceptance bound.
